title: Restyle the progress site in black and white with red accents
summary: The progress site drops its blue, green and amber colours. Pages now use black and white, and red marks the logo, section titles and the current or selected item. The presentation standard in docs/PROJECT_SITE.md records this palette and asks each page to show structure as a picture. Pages that load site/poster.css, such as the planned code map, take the same colours.
next: Apply the same palette and the picture-first rule to the locomotion code map on its branch.
reason: The change edits colours and the presentation guide; it changes no experiment, model, gate or recorded result.
